activities.name: Process
activities.whenToUse: Use to dispatch ForEachAdapter and ForEachActivity over the grid selected by ForEachPath. Omit or disable SupportParallelism for serial processing; Config.ResultDetail=true returns serial dispatch counts and keys after every child returns a nonfailed Signal.
activities.description: Process a plan through a conduit.

properties.description: Optional native Boolean. True returns serial child-dispatch counts and grid keys; absent/false preserves ItemSignal. True with SupportParallelism or invalid type fails before child effects.
properties.whenToUse: Set native Boolean true when serial dispatch counts and completed grid keys are needed. Omit or use false to return the source ItemSignal; true requires SupportParallelism absent or native Boolean false and rejects parallel execution before child effects.

properties.description: Provide the activity copied into the per-item dispatch plan.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the activity to use for grid-item dispatch. It is copied directly into the cloned Activity field before the process helper runs.

properties.description: Resolve the per-item activity after forwarding it into the cloned Activity field.
properties.whenToUse: Set the per-item activity explicitly when a specific operation is required. The helper resolves the forwarded Activity with a Read fallback; the original Plan.Activity is overwritten during cloning.

properties.description: Choose the mapped adapter for each grid item.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the mapped adapter route used for the grid items. It replaces Adapter in the dispatch clone before the helper selects its route.

properties.description: Select the ItemSignal grid to process.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the path in ItemSignal that resolves the source graph whose Grid entries should be processed.

properties.description: Name the process signal and iteration tracing.
properties.whenToUse: Provide an identifying name for the process-entry signal and iteration tracing before a grid item result becomes the local plan.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-phase reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain the framework parent-phase reference when present. The clone helper temporarily detaches it, then restores the same reference on the original and cloned plans; omit it when no parent phase is attached.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-plan reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain the framework parent-plan reference when present. The clone helper temporarily detaches it, then restores the same reference on the original and cloned plans; omit it when no parent plan is attached.

properties.description: Choose the serial versus parallel conduit branch.
properties.whenToUse: Omit or use false for serial processing; a one-item grid also uses the serial path. True selects the separate parallel path for other grid sizes and cannot be combined with Config.ResultDetail=true.

result.description: Source grid ItemSignal [computed] after all serial children succeed when Config.ResultDetail is absent/false.
Config.ResultDetail=true only after every serial child returns a nonfailed Signal; no success detail on failure.
Number of child invocations started in serial; a failing attempt produces no public detail.
Number of nonfailed child Signals returned; independent marker verifies domain effect.
Copied source Grid key for each completed child in serial order.
True for each returned nonfailed child, not proof of its intended effect.

resultNotes: ConduitCondenser: Serial child failure now fails Process and suppresses a success Result; normal mapped failure carries no Result. A nonfailed child and detail count do not prove its intended node effect.

activities.name: Graph
activities.whenToUse: Use to turn the array selected by Path in ItemSignal into a graph keyed by NamePath, which defaults to Name. The final Path segment supplies the graph name.

properties.description: Name the graph-plan signal and diagnostic messages.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a name for GraphPlan signal identity and diagnostics. The resulting graph name comes from the final segment of Path.

properties.description: Select the identifier field in each source-array item.
properties.whenToUse: Set the field path used to resolve each selected item identifier when it differs from Name; omit this property to use the Name default.

properties.description: Select the ItemSignal array and derive the graph name from the final path segment.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the ItemSignal path selecting the source array. Its final dot-delimited segment is also used to name the graph.

result.description: resolved graph inside nested Signal [computed]. When graph creation from formula source; graph helper returns nested graph Signal.
